subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Researchers have long debated the cause of mass extinctions at the end of the Permian period.
• A 2015 study concluded that massive volcanic eruptions in Siberia had triggered the extinctions.
• In 2022, a different study found that rock layers from the period contained high levels of nickel consistent with asteroid impact debris.
• That study concluded that an asteroid impact had caused the mass extinctions.
prompt: The student wants to describe how scientific understanding about the extinctions' cause has evolved. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Researchers have long debated the cause of the extinctions, with one study concluding that massive volcanic eruptions in Siberia had triggered them.
choices.B: Studies in 2015 and 2022 offered different explanations for the cause of the extinctions.
choices.C: A 2015 study concluded that volcanic eruptions had caused the extinctions, but new research suggests that an asteroid impact was responsible.
choices.D: Rock layers from the Permian period contained high levels of nickel consistent with asteroid impact debris, according to recent research.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence describes how scientific understanding of the extinctions' cause has evolved, explaining that new research suggests an asteroid impact was responsible instead of volcanic eruptions (as was previously believed).

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence references a recent finding but doesn't effectively describe how scientific understanding of the extinctions' cause has evolved.
